# Student debt tables (generated by scripts/scf_debt.py)

Survey of Consumer Finances 2016 and 2025. Dollars in 2025 dollars (R-CPI-U-RS, 2016 to 2025: prices up 34.5%). Own student debt only: loans for the person's own education. Standard errors combine imputation and replicate-weight variance (SCF MEANIT). A change passes if |z| > 1.645 (90% confidence).

## Student loan balances assigned to a person

| year | all ($bn, 2025$) | own education of reference person or spouse ($bn) | child or other relative ($bn) | multiple people ($bn) | 7th and later loans ($bn) | share assigned (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 1295 | 1093 | 200 | 0 | 2 | 84.4 |
| 2025 | 1150 | 984 | 159 | 0 | 7 | 85.6 |
